title: Oven Smoky Turkish Tomato Wrap
description: A smoky and crumbly Turkish dish featuring tomatoes, wrapped in a pandan leaf, perfect for a sick day, with an al-dente finish and ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the diced tomatoes, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and garlic.
Brush the pandan leaves with olive oil on both sides.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto the center of each pandan leaf.
Top the tomato mixture with crumbly Turkish cheese.
Fold the pandan leaves to form a wrap, and place them on a baking sheet.
Bake the wraps in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the wraps from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
